test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A purchased a book for ₹1,600. A sold it to B at a loss of 10% and B sold it to C at a loss of 20%. At what price did C purchase this book?
solution:
Given:

A purchased a book for ₹1,600. 

A sold it to B at a loss of 10% and B sold it to C at a loss of 20%.

Concept used:

Selling Price = Cost Price × (1 - Loss%)

Calculation:

Cost price occurred to B = 1600(1 - 10%) = ₹1440

Cost price occurred to C = 1440(1 - 20%) = ₹1152

∴ C purchased this book for ₹1152.
